name: PPA Native GEN Custody
scope: Testnet-only native GEN custody. An owner-authorized, Core-bound intent lets any caller emit the exact finalized native GEN transfer to the PPA Core recipient, with no owner or caller discretion over recipient or amount. Not part of the released PPA composition.

nativeAsset.custody: The PPANativeGenCustody Intelligent Contract's ghost-contract balance.

canonicalInput.consequence_id: non-empty string <= 128 chars; canonical PPA Core proposal_id
canonicalInput.ttl_seconds: positive decimal string, <= configured max_ttl and <= 604800
canonicalInput.recipient: 0x-prefixed 20-byte address; must equal the Core-derived recipient
canonicalInput.amount: positive decimal wei string; must equal the Core-derived amount
canonicalInput.core_binding: consequence.proposal_id, payment_id, decision_id, adapter_caller, requested_recipient, requested_amount, created_at; payment.to, payment.amount, payment.actor, payment.memo; account.status, account.rules.currency, account.rules.policy_version
canonicalInput.amount_convention: The PPA amount string is interpreted as native GEN base units (wei) in v0.1. No decimals-aware conversion.

canonicalOutput.AUTHORIZED: exact Core-bound intent persisted; no native value moved
canonicalOutput.SETTLEABLE: preview only: an AUTHORIZED intent would pass settlement checks now
canonicalOutput.PENDING_FINALITY: exact native value transfer emitted; child success is not observable by the vault
canonicalOutput.REJECTED: deterministic refusal persisted or returned; no native value moved
canonicalOutput.UNDETERMINED: unavailable Core/dependency; no intent and no emit

owns: Core-bound settlement intents and their status
owner, Core, adapter, currency, max TTL, pause configuration
doesNotOwn: PPA internal balances, payments, policies, consequences

dependencies: GenLayer native value transfer: @gl.public.write.payable, gl.message.value, self.balance, emit_transfer(on='finalized'), __on_errored_message__

composition.label: testnet native GEN custody extension
composition.note: The existing ppa composedUnits are unchanged. This capability is separate from ppa-custody v0.1 (NTEST ERC-20 mechanics) and must not be read as a released PPA component.

unsupported: automatic retry after a child-transaction failure
attributing a refund to a specific intent
claiming child success from the vault status alone
migration of existing PPA composition claims

evidence.local: PASS (2026-10-21): nomos_lint.py; nomos_converge.py check; genvm-lint check on readable and compact sources; 6/6 canonical vectors on both sources; 14/14 direct-VM tests on both sources (Core binding, deposit/settle accounting, replay, pause, expiry, wrong recipient/amount, insufficient custody, non-owner, wrong adapter, currency mismatch, missing consequence, refund hook, artifact freshness).
evidence.live: NOT_IMPLEMENTED: no native GEN deployment yet

deployment.reason: Bradbury currently rejects the readable source deploy because its estimate (~21.7M gas) is above the node transaction gas acceptance ceiling (~16-17M at 2026-10-21). The compact artifact is a semantics-preserving deterministic build with the same public method surface and storage annotations.
deployment.observedCeilingAtBuild: 16000000 accepted / 17000000 rejected (2026-10-21); ceiling is soft and variable
deployment.verification: The artifact passes the same 14 direct-VM tests and 6/6 canonical vectors. tests/test_compact_artifact.py fails if the artifact is stale.
deployment.notAWeakening: No public method, status, reason code, error string, storage annotation, or check is removed or relaxed.
